## History

After marrying [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), Robert Baxter changed his religious denomination to [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) out of offense when the [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) choir sang 'Behold the bridegroom cometh' as a collection piece as the couple walked up the aisle.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P18](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0018)_
